title.purpose: h3 — plaque, card, and menu-category titles.

shadows.name: button-glow

motion.name: ease-out

motion.name: sear-in

motion.name: steam-rise

motion.name: ember-breathe

components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-ember { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: #e06a22; color: #0b0a09; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px -12px rgba(224,106,34,0.65); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-btn-ember:hover, .ds-btn-ember:focus-visible { background: #ff8c47; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -10px rgba(255,140,71,0.55); } .ds-btn-ember:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet companion action beside the primary ember button.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #f3ead9; border: 1px solid rgba(243,234,217,0.24); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-btn-line:hover, .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { border-color: #e06a22; color: #ff8c47; }

components.name: Menu Row
components.description: The recurring content unit for every dish across both pages: name + description left, price in Butter right, divided by a hairline rule, warms on hover — no card shell.

components.css: .ds-menu-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 0.875rem; align-items: baseline; padding: 0.875rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(243,234,217,0.14); transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-menu-row:hover, .ds-menu-row:focus-within { background: rgba(224,106,34,0.06); } .ds-name { display: block; font-weight: 700; color: #f3ead9; } .ds-desc { display: block; font-size: 0.87rem; color: #8d8375; margin-top: 0.2rem; } .ds-price { font-family: 'Rye', serif; color: #f4c244; font-size: 1.15rem; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview: The site is the restaurant's own cast-iron comal, not a brand built to sit beside it. Everything — ground, dividers, motion, the featured-dish plaque — is drawn from the surface a family actually cooks on: seasoned iron gone near-black, ember heat glowing at the edges, steam rising off whatever is cooking now. This is a Persuade surface for a small-town Mexican family restaurant (Milton-Freewater, OR); the visual language exists to make the food look like it's still sizzling, not to look like a design system. The system rejects two nearby defaults on purpose: the flag-color-and-clipart 'Mexican restaurant' template, and the inverse overcorrection into upscale minimalist 'elevated Mexican' branding. Food is shown as authored line-art illustration rather than stock or placeholder photography — no real photos exist yet, and faking photographic material would be a worse lie than an honest illustration.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black cast-iron ground with ember-orange and butter-yellow as the only saturated colors
A display face built for branding, not typesetting — used sparingly, at scale
Depth from warm radial ember glow and soft blur, never a generic drop shadow
One recurring signature device: an organic charred/torn edge on plaques, made with an SVG turbulence filter
Motion is ambient and singular — steam rising through the hero headline, plus quiet hover states — never a repeated scroll-reveal on every section

rules.name: The One Price Color Rule
rules.body: Butter (#f4c244) is the only color a price is ever set in, on every page, every context.

rules.name: The Rye-Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Every heading tag (h1/h2/h3), on both pages, is set in Rye. A page with a mixed display face is off-system.

rules.name: The Ember-Only Glow Rule
rules.body: Every soft shadow or glow in the system is ember-orange tinted. A neutral gray shadow anywhere on this site is off-system.

dos: Do keep Butter (#f4c244) as the only price color, everywhere, on every page.
Do set every heading in Rye; never substitute a system font as a temporary display face.
Do tint every shadow/glow ember-orange; never use a neutral gray shadow.
Do show food as authored line-art/SVG illustration in the system's own palette when no real photography exists.
Do keep the charred-edge SVG filter reserved for the one or two plaques meant to read as branded/stamped.
donts: Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above any heading, anywhere on this site.
Don't build a row of same-size icon+heading+text cards as page structure; use the grill-rack pattern instead.
Don't isolate a price as a giant standalone stat. Prices sit inline with the dish name at title scale.
Don't repeat the same scroll-triggered fade/slide-up entrance on every section.
Don't fake photographic material with a CSS gradient or bevel standing in for a photo.
